fixed.how: In packages/runtime/src/session/budget-pause.ts, reasonSaysDone is now an allowlist. The reason is split at punctuation and 'and'. Each part must match one closed form. IS_DONE: an optional subject, is/are/was/were/has been, then a DONE_STATE word ('both are met', 'notes.md is written', 'each part of it was checked', 'all met', 'complete'). DOES_ALL: a subject that does it to all of it ('hosts.md covers each of them', 'each listed page gives its address', 'the file lists every page it names', 'I checked each one'). ALL_PASS: 'all tests pass', 'the tests pass'. NONE_LEFT: 'nothing remains', 'so nothing is left', 'no work left', 'no further work needed', 'no outstanding items'. A part fails if it holds any of these: a qualifier or hedge (QUALIFIED: partly, mostly, half, N%, some, most, 'two of the three', only, first, draft, main, core, happy, probably, seems, hopefully, I think, so far, and 'part(s)' unless each/every/all stands before it); an exception or condition (apart from, other than, save for, bar, besides, aside, short of, minus, without, once, after, when, if, until, unless, as soon as); a future (to be, will, can, next, later, awaiting, an infinitive 'to add'); work still to come; 'nothing', 'none' or 'nobody' as what is done; an order. Anything else is work. aboutWholeSet still requires isNothing, so a whole-set 'nothing' makes other items notes only when its reason passes this form. The ADR 0112 amendment point 3 was corrected in place and dated 2026-11-23. runtime.md, the code comment and the user guide were updated. Every W15-14, L3-research-1, L4-money-101 and l4c-workstate case stays green: the live F4, L3 and LC-C7 reports, the bench stand-in's note line, including one with a path ('src/pairing.js is written and each part of it was checked'), and all of the fixer's positive cases. fixed.how: SAYS_ONLY_NOTHING_LEFT now has a guard, (?!\s+of\b), so a line that starts 'none of' or 'nothing of' never reads through the general rule. No positive case needs 'None of the criteria need ...', so it was not kept. The rule now reads named groups through saysOnlyNothingLeft. What a line is about says nothing of it is left on its own only in two cases: its verb says what the set needs (NEEDS: require, ask for, call for, want, expect), or its preposition is 'for' or 'to meet'. Two kinds need a LEFT word before or after: a verb that only says what the set holds (HOLDS: lists, names, covers, included, mentions, describes, specifies, sets out), and a place (in, by, under, within, against, on, from, or NAMED_BY + in). The older NOTHING form follows the same rule: a bare 'nothing' or 'none' with 'in', 'by' or 'under' needs a LEFT word. 'within', 'for' and 'to meet' still read as nothing on their own, so W15-14's 'Nothing within the scope of the brief' is unchanged. These still read as nothing: 'Nothing the brief lists is outstanding', 'Nothing the brief names is needed', 'Nothing on the task is left to do', 'Nothing listed in the brief is left to be done', 'Nothing outstanding against the criteria', 'Nothing left in the brief' and 'None required by the criteria.'. Both composed cases now pause with exactly the sentences 'Write the round robin page ... listed 2 things left to do; CHF 0.04 is kept for its review.' and 'Write the standings page ... listed one thing left to do ...', both 'paused before its budget of CHF 0.15 ran out: it spent CHF 0.10', with cards 'Continue (CHF 0.16 more)' and 'Cancel task'. Neither task is reviewed.

not_done: The reason allowlist keeps a free subject slot (up to 5 words), guarded by word lists (QUALIFIED, EXCEPT_OR_IF, FUTURE, NOBODY, STILL_TO_COME, ORDER). A hedge or partial word that is not listed (for example 'allegedly', 'the visible parts' is caught but 'the visible ones' is not) could still pass inside a subject that ends in a done word. The clause shapes are closed; the subject's words are not.

'Nothing for the criteria: wrote the tests and the README' still reads as work, on the safe side. A first-person past verb with an object joined by 'and' is not one of the closed forms, because splitting at 'and' breaks the object.

update_log_suggestion: 2026-11-23 fixup-l4c-workstate (run L4, after the review of l4c-workstate): a 'Left to do' line that says nothing is left now counts only when every part of its reason says the work is done, whole ('Nothing for the criteria: both are met', '... all done, no work left'). A reason with a qualifier, a hedge, an exception, a condition or work still to come is work left, and the task pauses with its Continue card. Examples: 'Nothing for the task: mostly done', '... done apart from the tests', '... done once the tests are added', '... the code is written, docs next', '... probably done'. 'None of the deliverables included', 'Nothing the brief lists' and 'None in the brief' are work. A false whole-set 'nothing' never turns the next item into a note, and the items under a 'Left to do: nothing ...' heading line are read. ADR 0112's l4c-workstate amendment was corrected 2026-11-23. A session review's cause within 200 characters is shown whole. U-089 'Check in the app' addition: a run whose Left to do is '- Nothing for the criteria: the page is written; the tests come next' and '- Add the tests for the parser' pauses ('... listed 2 things left to do ...') with 'Continue (CHF x more)' and 'Cancel task', unreviewed.
